mapper.insert: insert into trace_event (trace_id, process_id, business_key, process_type, step_id, service_name, event_type, http_method, path, status, elapsed_ms, error_code, error_message, created_at) values (#{traceId}, #{processId}, #{businessKey}, #{processType}, #{stepId}, #{serviceName}, #{eventType}, #{httpMethod}, #{path}, #{status}, #{elapsedMs}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, trace_id as traceId, process_id as processId, business_key as businessKey, process_type as processType, step_id as stepId, service_name as serviceName, event_type as eventType, http_method as httpMethod, path, status, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_message as errorMessage, created_at as createdAt from trace_event order by id desc

select id, trace_id as traceId, process_id as processId, business_key as businessKey, process_type as processType, step_id as stepId, service_name as serviceName, event_type as eventType, http_method as httpMethod, path, status, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_message as errorMessage, created_at as createdAt from trace_event where trace_id = #{traceId} order by id asc

select id, trace_id as traceId, process_id as processId, business_key as businessKey, process_type as processType, step_id as stepId, service_name as serviceName, event_type as eventType, http_method as httpMethod, path, status, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_message as errorMessage, created_at as createdAt from trace_event where process_id = #{processId} order by id asc

select id, trace_id as traceId, process_id as processId, business_key as businessKey, process_type as processType, step_id as stepId, service_name as serviceName, event_type as eventType, http_method as httpMethod, path, status, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_message as errorMessage, created_at as createdAt from trace_event where process_id = #{param1} and trace_id = #{param2} order by id asc

select id, trace_id as traceId, process_id as processId, business_key as businessKey, process_type as processType, step_id as stepId, service_name as serviceName, event_type as eventType, http_method as httpMethod, path, status, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_message as errorMessage, created_at as createdAt from trace_event where status = #{status} order by id asc
